dataset.name: anandvermagmailcom/soybean-leaf-diseases (split test)
dataset.license: No licence declared on the dataset card. Downloaded on demand by the operator for local verification and not redistributed with this project.
dataset.splitNote: The source dataset's test split, held out from that dataset's train/validation splits. Overlap with the model's own training data (LeafNet plus the authors' field photos) is undocumented and cannot be excluded.
dataset.labelSource: ClassLabel feature names read from the parquet file's HuggingFace metadata
dataset.overlapWarning: The soybean model card states its own held-out photos came from its training datasets. This dataset is a separate small public set, but its provenance relative to LeafNet is not documented, so overlap cannot be excluded.

preprocessing.description: Resize(shorter side 224, bilinear) -> CenterCrop(224) -> ToTensor -> Normalize(mean=[0.485,0.456,0.406], std=[0.229,0.224,0.225]) (identical to timm.data.create_transform resolved from this model's published pretrained_cfg: input_size 224, crop_pct 1.0, crop_mode centre)

exclusions.note: Declared exclusions are evaluated and content-hashed like every other image, then omitted from the measured metrics only. They remain in the JSON report and manifest with their reason. No image is deleted, relabelled, or altered.
